title: Cloud Exit Evidence
user: People keeping a local fallback for cloud files who need an evidence-backed answer to whether their physical copy is complete enough to rely on.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that compares a cloud-provider export/listing or sync manifest with an offline destination, classifies coverage by folder/type/date, records excluded paths, and emits an exit-readiness report.
constraints: Read manifests/exports only; no credential storage in v1; distinguish backup from sync prominently; encrypt any saved manifests because paths can be sensitive.
